definition: Intelligent control is a class of control techniques that use various artificial intelligence computing approaches like neural networks, Bayesian probability, fuzzy logic, machine learning, reinforcement learning, evolutionary computation and genetic algorithms..
details: Intelligent control is a class of control techniques that use various artificial intelligence computing approaches like neural networks, Bayesian probability, fuzzy logic, machine learning, reinforcement learning, evolutionary computation and genetic algorithms.
story: Imagine a video game where the only feedback is the score ticking up or down — and you learn by playing a million rounds. Instead of being told the rules, it discovers them by living with the consequences. The machine is not handed the answers — it tries things, earns a reward or a miss, and slowly figures out what works. Reward, not instructions, is the teacher. That learn-by-reward loop is Intelligent control.
